scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "pnpm --dir server dev" "pnpm --dir client dev"
scripts.start: cross-env VITE_API_URL=/api/v1 VITE_WS_URL= pnpm build && concurrently -k -s first -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "pnpm start:api" "pnpm start:web"
scripts.start:api: cross-env NODE_ENV=production HOST=127.0.0.1 PORT=3100 ENABLE_TEST_RESET=false CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:4173,http://127.0.0.1:4173 pnpm --dir server start
scripts.build: pnpm --dir server build && pnpm --dir client build
scripts.test: pnpm --dir server test && pnpm --dir client test
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir server lint && pnpm --dir client lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir server typecheck && pnpm --dir client typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm --dir server check && pnpm --dir client check
